description: A round tabletop zen garden filled with white sand sits on top of a sheet of paper, with a small gray stone and a tan pebble inside the ring and a yellow mini rake nearby. The right hand holds the yellow rake and drags it through the sand in a smooth curved path, then lifts and sets the rake down to the right; both hands then move in to touch and adjust the garden ring and stones, with the left hand briefly holding the gray stone while the right hand steadies the ring.
